0022600211.text: The Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East) visit the Knicks (5-4, 5th in the East) in Milwaukee's 11th game of the season, and Milwaukee arrives on a six-game losing streak with a 0-4 road record, while New York has won three straight. Gary Trent Jr. is out for the Bucks with illness, and Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury for the Knicks and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-2, including a 127-98 loss to New York on February 27, 2026 in Milwaukee.
